reasoning: The distinct prefix gcds form a strict divisibility chain ending at1. The first permutation element must equal the chain maximum, with probability1/N. At a current gcd b, all previously exposed elements are multiples of b. The first remaining nonmultiple of b is uniform over all N-floor(N/b) such elements, and the next gcd equals a precisely for multiples a*t with gcd(t,b/a)=1. Inclusion-exclusion over distinct prime factors counts these choices; multiply transition probabilities using the prime modulus.
